items.title: Josh Jacobs: Practicing, but not expected to play Wednesday
items.text:
Jacobs (finger) participated in Monday's practice to some degree, but is still not expected to play Wednesday against the Rams, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Willis: Avoids surgery for now
items.text:
Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Trending toward not playing Wednesday
items.text:
Coach Matt LaFleur noted Monday that Jacobs (finger) remains unlikely to play in Wednesday's game against the Rams, Rob Demovsky of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Romeo Doubs: Could practice later this week
items.text:
Coach Mike Vrabel noted Monday that Doubs (shoulder) might return to practice later in the week, but at this stage it's too soon to tell if that will happen, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Unlikely for Week 12, per Vrabel
items.text:
Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said that he doesn't anticipate Brown (hamstring) playing Sunday against the Chargers, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
